instruction: A candid documentary photograph taken from behind at eye-level shows an outdoor grassy field with a dark forest background. The older man with a white beard (R1) in a brown sweater and dark pants walks away from the camera on the left. Beside him, the curly blonde boy in a plaid shirt (R2) walks in unison on the right. The older man has his right arm draped warmly over the boy's shoulder as they walk together. The scene is captured in soft, diffused evening light, featuring muted green and brown tones that evoke a quiet, affectionate mood.
